divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --fasta reference.fa [<the flag set's flags>] [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: GRCh37 chromosome 21, the GRCh37-hgvs corpus's reference.fa.gz decompressed, passed to both engines on every run
input: variants.vcf: 25 chromosome 21 records of the GRCh37-hgvs corpus (ClinVar GRCh37 and gnomAD v2.1.1; INFO, QUAL and FILTER dropped; records that corpus documents as diverging left out): the first record carrying each of the 30 consequence terms that corpus's reference produces (21 records), two more synonymous records and two more multi-base coding deletions, plus five records built a few bases past chosen ones with the reference base read from the FASTA: two and three alternate SNV alleles, an SNV beside an insertion, an alternate allele beside a `*`, and two deletions of different lengths
generator: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --suite flags=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers numbers --covers variant_class --covers show_ref_allele --covers allele_number --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --fasta-name ../GRCh37-hgvs/reference.fa.gz --out tests/golden/116/GRCh37-output-flags; build_golden_corpus.py flag-set (five sets); scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl <cache> <json> 21; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; build_golden_corpus.py classify (the default run and each flag set)
terms_json: Ensembl VEP 116.2 exits on --terms display or NCBI with --json (`Can't call method "rank" on an undefined value at OutputFactory/JSON.pm line 388`) for every record with two or more distinct terms, so the terms sets compare default, tab and vcf
